description: Pre-flight a campaign: how many people would be contacted, on which channels, what it would cost, and which checks pass, warn or fail. SENDS NOTHING. If everything passes, it returns a short-lived approval token and a confirmation phrase — both of which a human operator must authorise before launch_approved_campaign will do anything. Run this before every launch; the token is single-use and campaign-specific.

channel.description: How the campaign goes out. Default 'sms' (text + voice where applicable). 'email' reviews an email-only launch.

from_address_id.description: Email channel only: the sender identity to send from (see list_from_addresses). Omit to use the account default.

lead_ids.description: Review a subset of the campaign's leads. Omit for all of them.
